summary: Implemented App.call_from_thread in src/textual/app.py (plus thread-entry state in __init__ and run(), cleared in a finally) and added tests/test_concurrency.py with seven tests. All seven new tests pass when run with PYTHONPATH pointing at this repo's src, since the shared venv imports textual from base/. The wider suite shows 68 failures caused by the venv lacking async test support (async tests/fixtures not run); I did not confirm them against a baseline. Snapshot, CLI and devtools test directories were not run (devtools/cli fail to collect: missing aiohttp). Nothing committed. Known edge case: a call already queued on the loop when shutdown begins may still wait.
